verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing claims cover vulnerable-dependency updates (github-docs-6), reducing application vulnerabilities via security campaigns and Copilot Autofix (github-docs-14, github-docs-5), and leaked-secret detection with push protection (github-docs-7, github-docs-15). These imply first-party dependency and code security detection. However, the evidence is one-line marketing copy that never explicitly describes automatic repository scanning or how it is set up. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic dependency vulnerability scanning and alerts, explicit code scanning/static analysis docs, configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
